jobs.title: Global Treasury Sr. Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you ready to bring your treasury expertise into a global, purpose-driven organisation where finance plays a key role in enabling business growth and strategic transformation?

Zambon is looking for a Global Treasury Senior Specialist to join its Global Treasury team in Switzerland. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced treasury professional who wants to contribute to the management of Group liquidity, financial risk, banking relationships and treasury operations across an international environment.

In this role, you will bring together hands-on treasury expertise, strategic thinking and a continuous improvement mindset, working closely with stakeholders across local and global teams.

What you will do

• Ensure the smooth execution of Group treasury activities, ensuring liquidity, governance and alignment with global policies across centralized and non-centralized entities.

• Support business operations and strategic initiatives through effective cash management, cash pooling, intercompany funding and banking relationships.

• Monitor liquidity positions and cash forecasts to support informed and timely financial decisions.

• Partner with international banks and financial institutions, contributing to negotiations and cash management solutions.

• Contribute to the management of foreign exchange, interest rate, counterparty and liquidity risks.

• Drive continuous improvement, digitalisation and automation of treasury systems, tools and processes.

• Work closely with Accounting, Tax, Legal and Internal Control teams to ensure compliance and operational excellence.

• Prepare treasury reporting, KPIs, dashboards and presentations that provide meaningful insights to senior leadership.

What we are looking for

• A degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related field.

• +5 years of experience in Treasury or Corporate Finance within international and complex organisations.

• Solid experience with Treasury Management Systems, SWIFT, Bloomberg and ERP platforms; SAP S/4HANA experience would be a strong plus.

• Strong knowledge of financial markets, derivatives, cash pooling structures and international treasury best practices.

• Analytical mindset, collaborative approach and the ability to build trusted relationships across cultures and functions.

• Fluent English; any additional language will be considered a plus.

If you are passionate about treasury, enjoy working in an international environment and are motivated by the opportunity to make an impact, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Only candidates whose qualifications and experience match the required profile will be considered.

jobs.title: Buyer Procurement Indirect
jobs.description:
Zambon Switzerland SA , the Swiss affiliate of the multinational pharmaceutical group Zambon, based in Cadempino (Canton Ticino), is looking for a Buyer to join its Indirect Procurement team.

We are looking for a highly challenge-driven individual with a strong appetite for change and continuous improvement, who will contribute to the evolution of purchasing strategies and processes while developing valuable partnerships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

By leveraging advanced digital tools, the successful candidate will support the management of indirect spend categories and the optimization of internal processes, contributing to sustainable value creation for the organization in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.

Key responsibilities:

• Support and drive digitalization and innovation within Procurement processes through the use of Data Analytics and AI solutions, transforming data and market insights into effective purchasing strategies and actionable recommendations.

• Proactively conduct supplier scouting, qualification and evaluation activities at both national and international level, optimizing the supplier base and ensuring competitiveness, reliability and continuity of supply.

• Negotiate commercial agreements, contracts, Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring maximum value generation and optimization of the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

• Manage indirect procurement, MRO and CAPEX activities, including laboratory materials, industrial spare parts, services and Facility Management, from needs definition through negotiation and contract execution.

• Manage tenders and e-Sourcing processes through SAP Ariba (RFI, RFP, RFQ), supporting supplier onboarding, electronic catalogue management and the optimization of the Procure-to-Pay cycle.

• Analyze spend, TCO, market benchmarks and supplier performance, identifying opportunities for savings, cost optimization, vendor consolidation and risk mitigation.

• Monitor and develop relationships with strategic suppliers, promoting continuous improvement initiatives, compliance and long-term partnerships.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including Engineering, QA/QC, Finance, IT and Plant Operations, fostering effective collaboration, innovation and continuous process improvement.

The ideal candidate is:

• Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to interpret spend analysis, KPIs and market trends to identify optimization and value-creation opportunities.

• Focused on continuous improvement and open to change, able to leverage digitalization and new technologies to increase process effectiveness and support the business.

• Curious, proactive and autonomous, with the ability to set priorities and manage complex activities in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment.

• Strategically minded and results-oriented, with the ability to translate operational needs into effective and sustainable sourcing solutions.

• Passionate about negotiation and partnership development, with the ability to build strong relationships with suppliers and stakeholders in international and multi-stakeholder environments.

• Collaborative and influential, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to interact effectively with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Management Engineering, Economics, or a related field.

• At least 5 years of experience as a Buyer, with responsibility for managing indirect spend categories, preferably within the pharmaceutical, chemical or cosmetics industry.

• Solid knowledge of sourcing, supplier management and compliance in regulated environments (GMP).

• Knowledge of key regulations related to contractual compliance and data privacy.

• Proven hands-on experience with SAP Ariba (Sourcing, Buying and Contracts) and integration with ERP systems, preferably SAP S/4HANA.

• Good knowledge of analytics and data visualization tools, such as Power BI or equivalent.

• Strong negotiation, spend analysis and supplier management skills.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Are you the person we are looking for?

If you recognize yourself in this profile and would like to contribute to the growth of a company that promotes innovation, collaboration and sustainable value creation, we would be delighted to receive your application.

Only applications matching the profile sought will be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Zambon Svizzera SA, affiliata svizzera del gruppo farmaceutico multinazionale Zambon, con sede a Cadempino (Canton Ticino), sta cercando un Compratore di aderire al suo team di Indirect Procurement.

Siamo alla ricerca di un individuo altamente guidato dalla sfida con un forte desiderio di cambiamento e di miglioramento continuo, che contribuirà all'evoluzione delle strategie di acquisto e dei processi, sviluppando preziose partnership con fornitori e stakeholder interni.

Sfruttando strumenti digitali avanzati, il candidato di successo supporterà la gestione delle categorie di spesa indiretta e l'ottimizzazione dei processi interni, contribuendo alla creazione di valore sostenibile per l'organizzazione in un ambiente dinamico e in continua evoluzione.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Sostenere e guidare la digitalizzazione e l'innovazione all'interno dei processi di approvvigionamento attraverso l'utilizzo di soluzioni di Data Analytics e AI, trasformando i dati e le informazioni di mercato in strategie di acquisto efficaci e raccomandazioni attuabili.

• Proattivamente conduci attività di scouting, qualificazione e valutazione dei fornitori a livello nazionale e internazionale, ottimizzando la base dei fornitori e garantendo competitività, affidabilità e continuità dell'offerta.

• Negoziare accordi commerciali, contratti, accordi di livello di servizio (SLA) e indicatori di performance chiave (KPI), garantendo la massima generazione di valore e ottimizzazione del costo totale di proprietà (TCO).

• Gestisci le attività di approvvigionamento indiretto, MRO e CAPEX, compresi i materiali da laboratorio, i pezzi di ricambio industriali, i servizi e la gestione delle strutture, dalla definizione delle esigenze attraverso la negoziazione e l'esecuzione dei contratti.

• Gestire le offerte e i processi di e-Sourcing attraverso SAP Ariba (RFI, RFP, RFQ), supportare i fornitori di onboarding, gestione elettronica del catalogo e l'ottimizzazione del ciclo Procure-to-Pay.

• Analizza le prestazioni di spesa, TCO, benchmark di mercato e fornitori, identificando le opportunità di risparmio, ottimizzazione dei costi, consolidamento dei fornitori e mitigazione dei rischi.

• Monitorare e sviluppare relazioni con fornitori strategici, promuovendo iniziative di miglioramento continuo, conformità e partnership a lungo termine.

• Collabora con gli stakeholder interfunzionali, tra cui Engineering, QA/QC, Finance, IT e Plant Operations, promuovendo una collaborazione efficace, innovazione e miglioramento continuo dei processi.

Il candidato ideale è:

• Analitica e data-driven, con la capacità di interpretare l'analisi di spesa, i KPI e le tendenze di mercato per identificare opportunità di ottimizzazione e creazione di valore.

• Concentrati sul miglioramento continuo e aperti al cambiamento, in grado di sfruttare la digitalizzazione e le nuove tecnologie per aumentare l'efficacia del processo e supportare l'azienda.

• Curioso, proattivo e autonomo, con la capacità di fissare priorità e gestire attività complesse in un ambiente dinamico e in continua evoluzione.

• Strategicamente orientato ai risultati, con la capacità di tradurre le esigenze operative in soluzioni di approvvigionamento efficaci e sostenibili.

• Appassionato di negoziazione e sviluppo di partnership, con la capacità di costruire forti relazioni con fornitori e stakeholder in ambienti internazionali e multi-stakeholder.

• Collaborativo e influente, con eccellente comunicazione e competenze interpersonali e la capacità di interagire efficacemente con gli stakeholder interfunzionali a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione.

Requisiti:

• Laurea o Master in Ingegneria gestionale, Economia o un campo correlato.

• Almeno 5 anni di esperienza come Acquirente, con la responsabilità di gestire categorie di spesa indiretta, preferibilmente all'interno del settore farmaceutico, chimico o cosmetico.

• Conoscenza solida di approvvigionamento, gestione dei fornitori e conformità in ambienti regolamentati (GMP).

• Conoscenza delle normative chiave relative alla conformità contrattuale e alla privacy dei dati.

• Provata esperienza pratica con SAP Ariba (Sourcing, Buy and Contracts) e integrazione con i sistemi ERP, preferibilmente SAP S/4HANA.

• Buona conoscenza degli strumenti di analisi e visualizzazione dei dati, come Power BI o equivalente.

• Forte negoziazione, spendere analisi e competenze di gestione dei fornitori.

• Ottimo scritto e parlato inglese.

Sei tu la persona che stiamo cercando?

Se vi riconoscete in questo profilo e desiderate contribuire alla crescita di un'azienda che promuove innovazione, collaborazione e creazione di valore sostenibile, saremo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione.

Saranno prese in considerazione solo le applicazioni corrispondenti al profilo ricercato.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Zambon Switzerland SA, die Schweizer Tochtergesellschaft des multinationalen Pharmakonzerns Zambon mit Sitz in Cadempino (Ticino), sucht einen Käufer, der sich seinem Team für indirekte Beschaffung anschließt.

Wir suchen eine stark herausforderungsorientierte Person mit einem starken Appetit auf Veränderung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung, die zur Entwicklung von Einkaufsstrategien und -prozessen beiträgt und gleichzeitig wertvolle Partnerschaften mit Lieferanten und internen Stakeholdern entwickelt.

Durch die Nutzung fortschrittlicher digitaler Tools unterstützt der erfolgreiche Kandidat das Management indirekter Ausgabenkategorien und die Optimierung interner Prozesse und trägt so zu einer nachhaltigen Wertschöpfung für das Unternehmen in einem dynamischen und sich ständig weiterentwickelnden Umfeld bei.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Unterstützung und Förderung der Digitalisierung und Innovation in Beschaffungsprozessen durch den Einsatz von Data Analytics und KI-Lösungen, die Umwandlung von Daten und Markteinblicken in effektive Einkaufsstrategien und umsetzbare Empfehlungen.

• Proaktive Durchführung von Lieferanten-Scouting-, Qualifizierungs- und Bewertungsaktivitäten auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene, Optimierung der Lieferantenbasis und Gewährleistung von Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kontinuität der Versorgung.

• Verhandeln Sie kommerzielle Vereinbarungen, Verträge, Service Level Agreements (SLAs) und Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), um eine maximale Wertschöpfung und Optimierung der Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) zu gewährleisten.

• Verwalten Sie indirekte Beschaffungs-, MRO- und CAPEX-Aktivitäten, einschließlich Labormaterialien, Industrieersatzteile, Dienstleistungen und Facility Management, von der Bedarfsdefinition bis zur Verhandlungs- und Vertragsausführung.

• Verwalten Sie Ausschreibungen und E-Sourcing-Prozesse über SAP Ariba (RFI, RFP, RFQ), unterstützen Sie das Onboarding von Lieferanten, das elektronische Katalogmanagement und die Optimierung des Procure-to-Pay-Zyklus.

• Analysieren Sie Ausgaben, TCO, Marktbenchmarks und Lieferantenleistung und identifizieren Sie Einsparungsmöglichkeiten, Kostenoptimierung, Lieferantenkonsolidierung und Risikominderung.

• Überwachung und Entwicklung von Beziehungen zu strategischen Lieferanten, Förderung von Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, Compliance und langfristigen Partnerschaften.

• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern, einschließlich Engineering, QA / QC, Finanzen, IT und Anlagenbetrieb, um eine effektive Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und kontinuierliche Prozessverbesserung zu fördern.

Der ideale Kandidat ist:

• Analytisch und datengesteuert, mit der Fähigkeit, Ausgabenanalysen, KPIs und Markttrends zu interpretieren, um Optimierungs- und Wertschöpfungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren.

• Konzentriert auf kontinuierliche Verbesserung und offen für Veränderungen, in der Lage, Digitalisierung und neue Technologien zu nutzen, um die Prozesseffizienz zu erhöhen und das Geschäft zu unterstützen.

• Neugierig, proaktiv und autonom, mit der Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen und komplexe Aktivitäten in einer dynamischen und sich ständig weiterentwickelnden Umgebung zu verwalten.

• Strategisch ausgerichtet und ergebnisorientiert, mit der Fähigkeit, operative Anforderungen in effektive und nachhaltige Sourcing-Lösungen umzusetzen.

• Leidenschaft für Verhandlungen und Partnerschaftsentwicklung mit der Fähigkeit, starke Beziehungen zu Lieferanten und Stakeholdern in internationalen und Multi-Stakeholder-Umgebungen aufzubauen.

• Kollaborativ und einflussreich, mit hervorragenden Kommunikations- und zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten und der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen der Organisation zu interagieren.

Anforderungen:

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Management Engineering, Wirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Käufer mit Verantwortung für die Verwaltung indirekter Ausgabenkategorien, vorzugsweise in der Pharma-, Chemie- oder Kosmetikindustrie.

• Fundiertes Wissen über Beschaffung, Lieferantenmanagement und Compliance in regulierten Umgebungen (GMP).

• Kenntnis der wichtigsten Vorschriften im Zusammenhang mit der Einhaltung von Verträgen und dem Datenschutz.

• Bewährte Praxiserfahrung mit SAP Ariba (Sourcing, Buying und Contracts) und Integration mit ERP-Systemen, vorzugsweise SAP S/4HANA.

• Gute Kenntnisse der Analyse- und Datenvisualisierungstools, wie Power BI oder gleichwertig.

• Starke Verhandlungs-, Ausgabenanalyse- und Lieferantenmanagementfähigkeiten.

• Hervorragend geschriebenes und gesprochenes Englisch.

Sind Sie die Person, die wir suchen?

Wenn Sie sich in diesem Profil wiedererkennen und zum Wachstum eines Unternehmens beitragen möchten, das Innovation, Zusammenarbeit und nachhaltige Wertschöpfung fördert, freuen wir uns über Ihre Bewerbung.

Nur Anwendungen, die dem gesuchten Profil entsprechen, werden berücksichtigt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Zambon Switzerland SA , filiale suisse du groupe pharmaceutique multinational Zambon, basé à Cadempino (Canton Tessin), cherche un acheteur pour rejoindre son équipe d'approvisionnement indirect.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'une personne hautement motivée par le défi, qui aspire au changement et à l'amélioration continue, et qui contribuera à l'évolution des stratégies et des processus d'achat tout en établissant des partenariats précieux avec les fournisseurs et les intervenants internes.

En tirant parti des outils numériques avancés, le candidat retenu soutiendra la gestion des catégories de dépenses indirectes et l'optimisation des processus internes, contribuant à la création durable de valeur pour l'organisation dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution.

Principales responsabilités :

• Soutenir et stimuler la numérisation et l'innovation dans les processus d'approvisionnement en utilisant les solutions Data Analytics et AI, en transformant les données et les perspectives du marché en stratégies d'achat efficaces et en recommandations réalisables.

• Mener des activités proactives de dépistage, de qualification et d'évaluation des fournisseurs aux niveaux national et international, en optimisant la base des fournisseurs et en assurant la compétitivité, la fiabilité et la continuité de l'approvisionnement.

• Négocier des ententes commerciales, des contrats, des ententes sur les niveaux de service (ALS) et des indicateurs de rendement clés (ICP), garantissant la production de valeur maximale et l'optimisation du coût total de propriété (FTC).

• Gérer les activités d'achats indirects, de BRM et de CAPEX, y compris les matériaux de laboratoire, les pièces de rechange industrielles, les services et la gestion des installations, depuis la définition des besoins jusqu'à la négociation et l'exécution des contrats.

• Gérer les appels d'offres et les processus d'e-Sourcing par l'intermédiaire de SAP Ariba (RFI, DP, RFQ), soutenir le fournisseur embarqué, la gestion électronique du catalogue et l'optimisation du cycle Procure-to-Pay.

• Analyser les dépenses, TCO, les repères du marché et la performance des fournisseurs, identifier les possibilités d'économie, d'optimisation des coûts, de regroupement des fournisseurs et d'atténuation des risques.

• Surveiller et établir des relations avec les fournisseurs stratégiques, en favorisant les initiatives d'amélioration continue, la conformité et les partenariats à long terme.

• Collaborer avec les intervenants interfonctionnels, y compris l'ingénierie, l'AQ/CQ, les finances, les TI et les opérations des installations, en favorisant une collaboration efficace, l'innovation et l'amélioration continue des processus.

Le candidat idéal est :

• Analyse et données, avec la capacité d'interpréter l'analyse des dépenses, les ICR et les tendances du marché pour identifier les possibilités d'optimisation et de création de valeur.

• Axé sur l'amélioration continue et ouvert au changement, capable de tirer parti de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies pour accroître l'efficacité des processus et soutenir l'entreprise.

• Curieux, proactif et autonome, avec la capacité de fixer des priorités et de gérer des activités complexes dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution.

• Une approche stratégique et axée sur les résultats, avec la capacité de traduire les besoins opérationnels en solutions d'approvisionnement efficaces et durables.

• Passionné par la négociation et le développement de partenariats, avec la capacité d'établir des relations solides avec les fournisseurs et les intervenants dans des environnements internationaux et multipartites.

• Collaboration et influence, avec d'excellentes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles et la capacité d'interagir efficacement avec les intervenants interfonctionnels à tous les niveaux de l'organisation.

Exigences:

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie de gestion, en économie ou dans un domaine connexe.

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience en tant qu'acheteur, avec la responsabilité de gérer les catégories de dépenses indirectes, de préférence dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, chimique ou cosmétique.

• Connaissance approfondie de l'approvisionnement, de la gestion des fournisseurs et de la conformité dans les environnements réglementés (BPF).

• Connaissance des règlements clés relatifs à la conformité contractuelle et à la confidentialité des données.

• Expérience éprouvée avec SAP Ariba (Sourcing, Buying and Contracts) et intégration avec les systèmes ERP, de préférence SAP S/4HANA.

• Bonne connaissance des outils d'analyse et de visualisation des données, comme Power BI ou équivalent.

• Forte capacité de négociation, d'analyse et de gestion des fournisseurs.

• Excellent anglais écrit et parlé.

Vous êtes la personne que nous cherchons ?

Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ce profil et souhaitez contribuer à la croissance d'une entreprise qui favorise l'innovation, la collaboration et la création de valeur durable, nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature.

Seules les demandes correspondant au profil recherché seront prises en considération.

jobs.title: Stagista in Chimica e Tecnologia Farmaceutica
jobs.description:
Zambon Svizzera SA, azienda farmaceutica con sede a Cadempino (Svizzera) è alla ricerca di un/una stagista estremamente motivato/a ed entusiasta di mettersi alla prova per uno Stage in Chimica e Tecnologia Farmaceutica full time dalla durata di 1 anno presso il nostro Laboratorio di Manufacturing & Technological Support.

Le principali mansioni che rappresenteranno la quotidianità della nuova risorsa aggiunta saranno le seguenti:

• Eseguire esperimenti partecipando alla produzione di prodotti farmaceutici

• Predisporre gli opportuni protocolli di studio e conseguenti report sugli esperimenti eseguiti

• Curare la rintracciabilità dei dati grezzi e valutazioni aggiuntive

• Proporre approfondimenti e migliorie al processo tecnologico

• Vigilare sulle condizioni generali di igiene e pulizia del laboratorio e delle apparecchiature

• Utilizzare le apparecchiature e le strumentazioni rispettando le procedure vigenti e buone norme di laboratorio (GLP)

I requisiti previsti per la figura professionale che stiamo cercando sono i seguenti:

• Laurea in CTF / Farmacia / Chimica Industriale / Ingegneria chimica

• Nessuna o limitata esperienza pregressa in ambito similare

• Ottima conoscenza della Lingua Inglese

La nostra ricerca è rivolta a profili che si distinguono per le seguenti competenze:

• capacità di eseguire tecniche analitiche di base (HLPC)

• capacità di effettuare preparazioni galeniche

• forte attitudine analitica

• capacità pianificazione e gestione per obiettivi

• propensione al problem solving

Sei una persona curiosa, precisa e con una vera passione per la chimica farmaceutica?

Vuoi mettere in pratica ciò che hai studiato e far parte di un team che lavora su progetti reali e concreti?

Se sei tu la persona che stiamo cercando e ti riconosci nel profilo descrittivo, non perdere l'occasione di candidarti subito. Offriamo un’opportunità unica di formazione in un ambiente giovane, dinamico e stimolante. Non aspettare e fai la differenza!

Segui gli step di processo della candidatura con NCORE e goditi la candidate journey che sta per iniziare.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Zambon Switzerland SA, a pharmaceutical company based in Cadempino (Switzerland) is looking for an extremely motivated and enthusiastic stagist to test for a full-time Chemistry and Pharmaceutical Technology Stage lasting 1 year at our Manufacturing & Technological Support Laboratory.

The main tasks that will represent the everyday life of the new added resource will be as follows:

• Perform experiments by participating in the production of pharmaceutical products

• Prepare the appropriate study protocols and report on the experiments performed

• Care for traceability of raw data and additional evaluations

• Proposing insights and improvements to the technological process

• Check the general hygiene and cleaning conditions of the laboratory and equipment

• Use equipment and equipment in compliance with current procedures and good laboratory standards (GLP)

The requirements for the professional figure we are looking for are as follows:

• Degree in CTF / Pharmacy / Industrial Chemistry / Chemical Engineering

• No or limited previous experience in similar areas

• Great knowledge of the English language

Our research is aimed at profiles that stand out for the following skills:

• ability to perform basic analytical techniques (HLPC)

• ability to carry out gallenic preparations

• strong analytical attitude

• planning and management skills for objectives

• propensity to problem solving

Are you a curious, precise person with a real passion for pharmaceutical chemistry?

Do you want to put into practice what you have studied and be part of a team that works on real and concrete projects?

If you are the person we are looking for and recognize you in the descriptive profile, do not miss the opportunity to apply immediately. We offer a unique opportunity of training in a young, dynamic and challenging environment. Don't wait and make a difference!

Follow the application process steps with NCORE and enjoy the candidate journey that is about to begin.

Only applications that match what is sought will be evaded.
